voice.summary: Parcelo sounds like a friendly adviser who asks three questions and gives one answer. It is brisk, jargon-free and open about price, and it never makes the reader feel they chose the wrong plan.
dos: Ask one question at a time in plain words
Recommend one plan and say why
State the price per seat per month, with annual savings
donts: Do not push the dearest plan

taglines: Find the plan that fits your team
Pick a plan, not a puzzle
boilerplate: Parcelo is shipping and parcel software priced by seat, helping teams pick the right plan with a three-question quiz.

microcopy.success: Based on your answers, we recommend Studio.
microcopy.empty: No answers yet. Start with team size.

logo.note: A shopping bag stands for parcels and packages in transit.
